title: 第0366章 花呗呗抉择随行入学第0365章 小队商议大学规划
content_zh:
凰溪岛的风，终于褪去了连日的紧绷肃杀。
持续半月的武道高考预选风波彻底落幕，考场渗透、邪神卧底、世家暗箱操作一连串乱象被武道联盟连根拔起。尘埃落定，留在所有人心头的，只剩酣畅淋漓的逆袭，以及对未来武道前路的无限期许。
岛上大街小巷，随处可见欢庆的人流。
往届多年，凰溪岛作为都市与废土交界的边缘岛屿，能考入主城顶级武道大学的学子寥寥无几，往往数年才出一位。
可今年不一样。
才依依以绝对碾压之势，拿下本届武道高考预选状元，冠绝江南片区。
贾黑米从人人轻视的凰溪废柴，一路逆势翻盘，稳坐探花席位。
一岛双骄，横空出世。
这份成绩，放在整个江南武道圈，都是数年难遇的盛况。
落日余晖洒在海边武道广场，海风裹挟着淡淡的气血热浪，吹散了连日厮杀留下的血腥味。广场中央，不少岛上居民、武道学员围聚闲谈，话题始终绕着两位少年天才打转。
“真不敢相信，贾黑米那小子真的站起来了！半年前还是气血堪堪破百的废柴，现在硬生生杀到了预选第三！”
“心灵序列果然诡异，谁能想到，最不起眼的冷门序列，偏偏能克制邪神低语，稳压一众强攻序列！”
“才大小姐更是无解，顶级武道血脉加持，气血雄浑厚重，同阶无人能挡，这次主城统考，绝对能冲全国前十！”
议论声入耳，贾黑米神色平静，并无半分骄矜。
旁人只看见他一朝成名、风光无限，只有他自己清楚，这一路走来，熬过多少瓶颈、扛过多少侵蚀、在无数个深夜硬扛邪神低语的折磨。
风光从来不是凭空来的，是一步一个血脚印踏出来的。
广场僻静的石阶上，小队四人一猫齐聚一处，难得清闲。
叶利西倚着栏杆，一身素色布衣，白发随风轻扬，百岁老者眼神通透，静静看着眼前的少年少女，眼底满是欣慰。
短短半年，贾黑米脱胎换骨。
气血稳固三百赫，稳居武者境后期，心灵者二阶序列彻底扎根，心性、韧性、杀伐决断，早已远超同龄武者。

这株曾经濒临枯萎的顽苗，如今已然长成可扛风雨的参天嫩木。
“高考落幕，只是起步。”
叶利西缓缓开口，声音不大，却字字清晰，带着历经百年沧桑的厚重，“主城武道大学，是真正的龙虎汇聚之地。天才扎堆，强者如云，资源遍地，杀机也遍地。”
“凰溪岛的这点风浪，放在主城，不值一提。”
一句话，瞬间让热闹的氛围沉静下来。
才依依微微颔首，清冷的眉眼带着几分凝重：“我自幼在主城武道世家长大，清楚顶级武校的规则。那里不讲天赋出身，只论实力强弱。资源有限，席位有限，每一份修炼资源，都需要靠争抢换来。”
世家弟子、顶级天才、古老传承、稀有序列……
主城汇聚了整个蓝星年轻一辈的顶尖战力，相比于主城的天才圈层，凰溪岛的争锋，不过是孩童打闹。
贾黑米盘膝坐于石阶，闭目调息，稳固刚刚突破的气血与序列境界，闻言睁眼沉声道：“我明白。留在凰溪岛，一辈子都是井底之蛙。想要守住这里，想要对抗邪神侵蚀，唯一的路，就是往上走，走到更高的舞台，拿到更强的力量。”
他的根在凰溪岛，他的羁绊、他的使命、他要守护的一切，都在这里。
可他更清楚，弱者的守护，从来都是空谈。
唯有登临巅峰，手握强权实力，才有资格守护一方安宁，才有资格对抗盘踞世间的虚无邪神。
“接下来，就是主城入学、武校修行、备战全国统考。”
贾黑米目光扫过众人，落在身旁一身干练短衫的花呗呗身上，轻声道：“接下来的路，怎么走，大家各自可以做决定。”
话音落下，所有人的目光，都下意识聚焦在花呗呗身上。
小队四人，前路早已清晰。
才依依本就是主城世家千金，考入顶级武校，回归主城修行，本就是她的既定道路。
贾黑米金榜题名，手握顶级武校录取通知书，必然前往主城深造。
content_en:
The wind on Huangxi Island finally faded away from the tense and chilling feeling of the past few days.
The pre-selection crisis for the martial arts college entrance examination that lasted for half a month has come to an end. A series of chaotic events including examination room infiltration, evil undercover agents, and secret operations of aristocratic families were uprooted by the martial arts alliance. When the dust settled, what remained in everyone's mind was the hearty counterattack and the infinite expectations for the future of martial arts.
Celebrating people can be seen everywhere in the streets and alleys of the island.
In the past many years, Huangxi Island was an island on the edge of the border between the city and the wasteland. There were very few students who could be admitted to the top martial arts universities in the main city, and it usually took several years to get one.
But this year is different.
Cai Yiyi used an absolute crushing force to win the first place in the preliminaries for this year's martial arts college entrance examination, ranking first in the Jiangnan area.
Jia Heimi went from being a loser in Huangxi, which everyone despised, to bucking the trend and making a comeback, firmly occupying the top spot.
One island and two prides were born out of nowhere.
This achievement, in the entire Jiangnan martial arts circle, is a rare event in several years.
The afterglow of the setting sun shone on the seaside martial arts square, and the sea breeze carried a faint heat wave of blood and blood, blowing away the bloody smell left by the days of fighting. In the center of the square, many island residents and martial arts students gathered around and chatted, and the topic always revolved around the two young geniuses.
"I can't believe it, that kid Jia Heimi really stood up! Half a year ago, he was a loser with a blood level of over 100, and now he has managed to reach third place in the pre-selection!"
"The mind sequence is really weird. Who would have thought that the most inconspicuous and unpopular sequence can restrain the whisper of the evil god and stabilize the pressure of a group of powerful attack sequences!"
"Miss Cai is even more incomprehensible. With the blessing of top-level martial arts bloodline, her Qi and blood are strong and thick, no one at the same level can stop her. This time in the unified examination of the main city, she will definitely be among the top ten in the country!"
After hearing the discussion, Jiahemi looked calm and not at all arrogant.
Others only saw his sudden fame and glory, but only he knew how many bottlenecks he had overcome along the way, how much erosion he had endured, and how many nights he had endured the torture of whispers from evil gods.
Scenery never comes out of thin air, it is created step by step.
On the secluded stone steps of the square, the team of four people and one cat gathered together, enjoying a rare moment of leisure.
Ye Lixi was leaning on the railing, dressed in plain cloth, with white hair blowing in the wind. The centenarian had clear eyes and looked at the young girl in front of him quietly, his eyes filled with relief.
In just six months, Jiahemi was completely transformed.
Qi and blood are stable at 300 Hz, and he is firmly in the late stage of the warrior realm. The second level of the psychic sequence has completely taken root. His character, toughness, and decisiveness in killing have already far exceeded those of warriors of the same age.
This stubborn seedling that was once on the verge of withering has now grown into a towering young tree that can withstand wind and rain.
"The college entrance examination is over, but it's just the beginning."
Ye Lixi spoke slowly, his voice was not loud, but his words were clear, with the weight of hundreds of years of vicissitudes, "The martial arts university in the main city is a real place where dragons and tigers gather. Geniuses gather together, strong men are like clouds, resources are everywhere, and murderous intentions are everywhere."
"The storms on Huangxi Island are not worth mentioning in the main city."
One sentence instantly calmed down the lively atmosphere.
Cai Yiyi nodded slightly, and her cold brows were a bit solemn: "I grew up in a martial arts family in the main city, and I know the rules of the top martial arts schools. There is no talk of talent and origin, only strength. Resources are limited, seats are limited, and every training resource needs to be fought for."
Disciples of aristocratic families, top geniuses, ancient inheritance, rare sequences...
The main city has gathered the top combat power of the entire younger generation of Blue Star. Compared to the circle of geniuses in the main city, the competition on Huangxi Island is nothing more than children's play.
Jia Heimi sat cross-legged on the stone steps, closed his eyes and adjusted his breath to stabilize the realm of Qi, blood and sequence that he had just broken through. After hearing this, he opened his eyes and said solemnly: "I understand. If you stay on Huangxi Island, you will be a frog in the well for the rest of your life. If you want to defend this place and fight against the erosion of the evil god, the only way is to go up, to a higher stage, and get stronger power."
His roots are in Huangxi Island. His bond, his mission, and everything he wants to protect are allHere it is.
But he knows better that the protection of the weak is always empty talk.
Only by reaching the pinnacle and possessing powerful strength can one be qualified to protect a place's peace and to fight against the evil god of nothingness that dominates the world.
"The next step is to enroll in the main city, practice in the martial arts school, and prepare for the national unified examination."
Jia Heimi's eyes swept across the crowd and landed on Hua Beibei, who was wearing a smart short shirt next to him. He said softly: "Everyone can make a decision on the next road and how to go."
After the words fell, everyone's eyes subconsciously focused on Hua Beibei.
The team of four has a clear path ahead.
Cai Yiyi was originally the daughter of a wealthy family in the main city. It was her destined path to be admitted to a top martial arts school and return to the main city to practice.
Jia Heimi is on the gold medal list and holds an admission notice from a top martial arts school. He is bound to go to the main city to further his studies.
